'''2009 Coruscant Regionals Greg Shaw DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Greg Shaw]] at [[2009 Coruscant Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Ref2-D-agentsofblacksun.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Stealthblind
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
